advancements.sourceofmystery.root.title: Source of Mystery

advancements.sourceofmystery.touch_dark_: Obtain the Dark Source Chestplate or Dark Source Sword. Next: slay the Ender Dragon for a Dragon Soul
advancements.sourceofmystery.can_slayer_: Obtain the Origin Dragon Chestplate or Origin Dragon Sword. Next: slay the Ender Dragon again and face what descends

advancements.sourceofmystery.become_heav: Obtain Divine Punishment or Divine Blessing
